9mothers-9-mothers:ashbyhq:d04104fd-1349.title: Technical Project Manager
9mothers-9-mothers:ashbyhq:d04104fd-1349.description: Location: Onsite — Austin, TX Employment Type: Direct Hire, Full-Time Job Title: Technical Project Manager About 9 Mothers The modern battlefield has changed. Cheap, autonomous suicide drones have turned the tactical advantage upside down, and the world is looking for a solution. At 9 Mothers, we aren’t just "innovating"—we are building the shield. Backed by top-tier investors, we develop AI powered machines designed to intercept and neutralize Group 1/sUAS threats in real-time. Our flagship product is a low-power, counter-drone system built for the edge—on vehicles, at bases, or in a soldier's pack. Why 9 Mothers? While others build for "awareness" or "long-term research," we build for the immediate survival of those in harm’s way. We are a team of hackers, engineers, and mission-driven builders who value field-ready capability over polished slide decks. If you want to see your code or hardware in the field next month—not next year—this is your playground. Position Summary You will be our first dedicated project manager, and your job is to fix that. You own the work breakdown structure and the integrated schedule. You run the weekly coordination rhythm, record every task and decision so nothing is dropped, and stay ahead of the risks that quietly kill hardware schedules: long-lead parts, manpower shortages and skill gaps, missing equipment and infrastructure. Leadership will continue to set priorities, assign responsibility, and hold people accountable; your job is to make the plan legible and current so those decisions are made with real information, and so every person on the team knows what they need to be doing and when. This is a role for someone who treats a well-built Gantt chart as a love language. Your best days end with the ambiguity banished from the plan and a name and a date on everything that matters. We are a startup: the process you bring must be the lightweight 20% that delivers 80% of the value, not a bureaucracy the team routes around. Essential Duties Schedule & WBS Ownership (Primary) - Build and own the work breakdown structure across our product lines: decompose engineering, manufacturing, test, and delivery work into tasks with owners, durations, dependencies, and dates - Build and maintain the integrated master schedule in a Gantt-based tool; keep it current enough that the team and leadership trust it as the single source of truth for what happens when - Identify and track the critical path; flag slips early and quantify their downstream impact so leadership can re-prioritize before a deadline is blown, not after - Translate customer commitments, demo dates, and test events into backward-planned schedules with explicit margin Risk & Dependency Management - Maintain a living risk register for the things that actually derail hardware programs: long-lead and allocated parts, manpower shortages and skill gaps, missing equipment, tooling, and facility/infrastructure needs - Chase dependencies across engineering, purchasing, and the shop: surface the part that isn’t ordered, the fixture that isn’t built, and the test range that isn’t booked while there is still time to fix it - Work with the buyer on long-lead procurement timing so build schedules are planned around real lead times, and with leadership on staffing gaps before they become schedule slips Coordination, Tasking & Communication - Run the weekly coordination meeting: set the agenda, drive it to decisions, and finish with every action item recorded with an owner and a due date - Be the recorder of tasking for the company: capture tasks and decisions from meetings, hallway conversations, and test events into one tracked system so nothing is missed or forgotten - Follow up on open actions between meetings; keep status honest without becoming the person the team hides from - Give leadership a clear, current picture of status, risks, and upcoming decisions that is short, factual, and free of surprises Building the Structure - Stand up the company’s p

By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. THE ROLE We’re looking for a high-performing strategic finance professional to join our growing GTM Finance team. Our business grows with our customers' usage, which makes the finance function highly strategic at Baseten: growth, pricing, margin, and capacity decisions are business model decisions. You'll sit at the center of them, partnering directly with GTM leadership and reporting into a finance team with a seat at the table for the calls that shape the company's trajectory. This role is ideal for someone with 3 to 7 years of experience across strategic finance, investing, and/or investment banking who wants broad exposure to company-building inside a fast-scaling AI infrastructure company. Experience at a usage-based software company is a plus. Apply now to embark on a rewarding journey in shaping the future of AI! If you are a motivated individual with a passion for machine learning and a desire to be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking team, we would love to hear from you. At Baseten, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. jobgether-jobgether:lever:065fa78c-20e4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Google Cloud Delivery Architect based in United Kingdom. This is a senior, hands-on cloud architecture role focused on delivering complex Google Cloud engagements from design through implementation and handover. You will take ownership of scoped, fixed-budget projects and translate customer requirements into reliable production environments. The role combines cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, Kubernetes, networking, security, and DevOps expertise. You will work directly with customers, lead technical discussions, and manage several engagements in parallel. You’ll also drive cloud migrations, establish secure landing zones, and modernize infrastructure through automation and GitOps. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on enterprise cloud transformation while operating with significant technical and delivery ownership. Own the end-to-end delivery of Google Cloud engagements, from low-level design and implementation through validation, documentation, knowledge transfer, and final handover. Design and execute cloud migrations from AWS or Azure to Google Cloud, including production workloads such as EKS to GKE, RDS to Cloud SQL, and S3 to Cloud Storage. Design and implement secure Google Cloud foundations and landing zones covering resource hierarchies, IAM, organization policies, networking, and security controls, with infrastructure codified in Terraform. Architect and deploy production-grade GKE environments, including private clusters, node pools, Workload Identity, Helm-based add-ons, ingress, autoscaling, and Cloud Armor. Enable DevOps and infrastructure automation by importing existing environments into Terraform, developing reusable modules, and implementing CI/CD and GitOps workflows using tools such as GitHub Actions and Argo CD. Manage multiple customer engagements simultaneously, maintaining delivery plans, project hours, scope, budgets, and timelines while identifying risks and budget deviations early. Lead customer-facing workshops, weekly meetings, technical discussions, and handover sessions with engineering teams, technical leaders, and CTO-level stakeholders. Protect project scope through effective change management and ensure that all delivered environments are supported by clear documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer. Apply AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully in architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, and delivery workflows while maintaining strong technical judgment and quality standards. Requirements 5+ years of hands-on cloud infrastructure and architecture experience, with deep production experience specifically in Google Cloud. Strong expertise in Terraform, including reusable and modular infrastructure code, remote state management, and importing manually provisioned environments. Proven production experience with Kubernetes and GKE, including private clusters, node pools, autoscaling, RBAC, Workload Identity, Helm, and ingress. Strong knowledge of Google Cloud networking and security, including VPC architecture, Cloud NAT, DNS, VPN, Private Service Connect, firewall policies, IAM, Organization Policies, and Secret Manager. Practical experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices, including GitHub Actions or equivalent, keyless authentication to Google Cloud, container workflows, and GitOps with Argo CD or similar tools. Working knowledge of AWS or Azure, with the ability to understand and assess source-cloud environments as part of migration projects. Strong customer-facing English communication skills, with confidence leading technical workshops, weekly meetings, presentations, and handovers. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple technical engagements, work within defined budgets and scopes, and take ownership of delivery outcomes. southparkcommons-vori:ashbyhq:a544737e-b.description: JOB DESCRIPTION At Vori, Forward Deployed Data Engineers bridge the gap between customer systems and our modern grocery platform. You’ll work closely with onboarding managers to configure Vori for each retailer’s unique needs—reducing out-of-stocks, cutting shrink, and driving efficiency. As one of the Founding Forward Deployed Data Engineers, you won’t just be implementing processes—you’ll be defining them from the ground up. You’ll create the playbooks, data pipelines, and integration systems that allow Vori to scale from our first customers to thousands of stores. This role is hands-on with data. You’ll wrangle item files and invoices from POS systems, back-office tools, and ERPs—in formats ranging from CSV and EDI to PDFs and even scanned paper—and connect them seamlessly into Vori. Fluency with SQL and data manipulation is essential. We’re looking for motivated, detail-oriented engineers who thrive at the intersection of people, data, and infrastructure. If you love solving messy integration problems, collaborating with customers, and making technology work in the real world, you’ll feel right at home at Vori. RESPONSIBILITIES: - Understand the VoriOS system end to end and interdependencies between the system and its integration components - Understanding Customer’s needs to define and configure system specifications - Configure and maintain data mappings and reconciliation as an integral part of our operations team - Ability to thrive in a cross-functional environment and work closely with Operations, Product, Engineering teams on how to improve workflows and systems end to end QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years in FD/Solutions Engineering, or a similar customer-facing technical role, ideally in B2B SaaS or fintech - Hybrid skillset — strong backend/data engineering fundamentals + ability to interact directly with customer IT teams. - Domain awareness — familiarity with unstructured data, ETL processes and ML/OCR pipelines. - Customer empathy — comfort in troubleshooting messy, high-pressure customer environments. - Bias for autonomy — capable of managing extraction, ingestion, and pipeline tuning with minimal guidance. - SQL, Regex and scripting proficiency and willingness to learn new technologies. GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES - Get excited to learn more about complex data systems on the tech side as well as business challenges the grocery industry faces everyday - Confront and conquer unique, real-world problems that enhance your problem-solving abilities and challenge you to perform well with high velocity EXPECTATIONS - You will be stretched and challenged with a large scope of work, and fast paced deadlines. This role is for folks that want to make a dent in a $1T industry — which requires consistent force of will and large doses of daily creativity - Vori is NOT a simple 9-5 job 💯. We are building a Seal Team 6 of individuals who work hard, long, and smart to deliver exceptional results on limited resources. As a startup we constantly have to prove our right to exist. But if we win, we have the chance to transform the most fundamental industry on earth — food. Are you in? WHY VORI - Mission-driven team building tech that helps local businesses thrive - Backed by top investors and advisors from Stripe, Uber, Palantir, and Toast - Real revenue, real growth, and a massive market opportunity - A chance to shape not just marketing—but the company's future

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we need? The Entry Ride Operator is the conductor and entertainer for our members while making sure all vehicles are being processed safely and efficiently into the car wash tunnel. The Entry Ride Operator interacts with all customers and is responsible for exterior site cleanliness and creating a memorable experience in all interactions while preparing the vehicles prior to entering the car wash tunnel. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality. We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members.
